_comment: Porter MCP server for JetBrains Junie (+ JetBrains AI Assistant). HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json (user-level) or .junie/mcp/mcp.json (project-level). Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. For the JetBrains AI Assistant (non-Junie), use Settings > Tools > AI Assistant > MCP and paste the porter server JSON instead (no file). UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Junie install here.
